decontamination_notes: Real feature from python-attrs/attrs PR #1592, merged 2026-08-01, after model training cutoffs, so the specific implementation is novel. Repo sliced at the PR's base commit b56f28c (src/attr + src/attrs + pyproject.toml + MIT LICENSE); attrs is dependency-free, so tests run on the base sandbox image with PYTHONPATH=src. Adds generator support to on_setattr hooks: pre-yield code runs before the set, the yielded value is stored, post-yield code runs after. Hidden tests assert observable attrs behavior (stored attribute values and hook side effects) via the public API, never the internal _lazy_is_generator helper. Run with -c /dev/null so the repo's pytest config is ignored.
